query:
INSERT IGNORE INTO transformation_recipe_impacts (transformation_id, recette_id, impact_type, impact_description, olfactory_contribution, notes)
SELECT 
  mt.id,
  r.id,
  CASE 
    WHEN mt.transformation_type = 'pyrolysis' THEN 'major'
    WHEN mt.transformation_type = 'oxidation' THEN 'moderate'
    ELSE 'minor'
  END as impact_type,
  CONCAT('Transformation de ', mt.source_molecule_name, ' en ', mt.product_molecule_name, ' lors de la combustion') as impact_description,
  COALESCE(mt.olfactory_change_description, 'Notes fumées caractéristiques') as olfactory_contribution,
  'Liaison encens - combustion' as notes_val
FROM molecular_transformations mt
CROSS JOIN recettes r
WHERE r.category = 'encens';
